title: SOSV Deep Tech Summit — Eric Ries interviews Steve Blank on how AI forced him to rebuild the Lean LaunchPad
summary: SOSV's Deep Tech Summit ran free and virtual from 4 to 6 November, with 100 speakers across climate tech, human health and AI for the physical world. Eric interviewed Steve Blank about rebuilding the Lean LaunchPad course he launched at Stanford 15 years ago, after AI made a polished prototype the easy part.
blockquote: Steve will be joining our 𝐒𝐎𝐒𝐕 𝐃𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡 𝐒𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐢𝐭 (Nov. 4-6) to discuss startups in the new AI era, alongside Eric Ries, author of The Lean Startup and Incorruptible.
